description.value: A Walmart Supercenter located in Prince George, BC, offering a broad range of groceries alongside general merchandise including electronics, clothing, toys, and furniture. As one of the larger retail destinations in the Central Interior, it serves as a convenient resupply point for touring cyclists passing through Prince George. The supercenter format means a full grocery section is available alongside household goods and other supplies.
